The RAN5 second milestone including the first set of RF test cases is important to enable external certification organizations, such as GCF and PTCRB, to start preparing for early 5G NR device certification. This requires that the RAN5 associated TSs and TRs are published as approved 3GPP specification (v15.0.0). At RAN#80 the RAN5 TSs for the protocol test cases were approved as v15.0.0. Title: Specification quality improvement for 37.571-1 clause 15 Reason for change: In RAN4#113 and RN4#114, RAN4 agreed on a number of CRs to TS 38.133 to improve RAN4 RRM specification quality, which impact RAN5 positioning specification. Summary of change: (clauses 15) Applied changes: RB PRB in measurement accuracy requirements clauses: 15.3 and 15.5. MGRP max MGRP_max in TC 15.2.5 and TC 15.2.8 Editorial changes Wording changes Consequences if not approved: RAN5 positioning performance specification will not fully align with RAN4 Clauses affected: 15

Title: Specification quality improvement for 37.571-1 clause 4 Reason for change: In RAN4#113 and RN4#114, RAN4 agreed on a number of CRs to TS 38.133 to improve RAN4 RRM specification quality, which impact RAN5 positioning specification. Summary of change: (clauses 4) Applied changes: Delete brackets [] in clauses: 4.14.6.1, 4.14.6.2, 4.14.6.3, 4.15.6.1, 4.15.6.2 and 4.15.6.3. RB PRB in measurement accuracy requirements clauses: 4.14.5, 4.15.5 and 4.16.5. MGRP max MGRP_max Added missing hyphens: PRS RSRP PRS-RSRP Editorial changes Corrected typos Corrected notation Consequences if not approved: RAN5 positioning performance specification will be not fully align with RAN4 Clauses affected: 4.14, 4.15, 4.16
